about: SCION-04 · what the dog did, measured per scene frame from its own rendered mould (centroid of the torso polygon as rendered, head centroid vs torso, height of the back). x_screen/y_screen are px of the torso centroid; x_world_measured inverts the camera; facing: door = head toward the threshold, away = back turned; posture from the height of the back above the porch.
